entities.summary: The Danyang Woo clan is a Korean clan. Their Bon-gwan is in Danyang County, North Chungcheong Province. According to the 2015 census, the number of members was 191,287. Their founder is U Hyŏn who was said to be a descendant of mythical Yu the Great, however, due to a lack of ancestry literature, it is impossible to research if this is true.
